answer: Each identity claims one willow post on an inlet ledge and stakes a 90-credit bond. In the muster minute it files its willow mark, ledge id, and timestamp. Auditors check the log: one mark anchors one post; outside that minute, the bond burns. A post costs 38 to open, each further post 8 more than the last, so the thousandth costs 8030 and a thousand cost 4034000, with 90000 in bonds held. One operator pays one fee and one bond, returned if clean. A hired-post ring fails: a borrowed post carries its owner's mark, and no operator can attend ledges at inlets in one minute.
